links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT skin cancer screening responses versus recommended sixth grade level
links.effect: Both websites and ChatGPT responses exceeded the recommended sixth grade reading level; ChatGPT responses were significantly more difficult to read across all readability metrics.
links.quote: However, across all readability metrics, ChatGPT responses were significantly more difficult to read.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of online and ChatGPT skin cancer screening materials versus recommended level
links.effect: Websites and ChatGPT responses both exceeded the recommended sixth grade reading level for health information; ChatGPT was significantly harder to read on all five metrics.
links.quote: Results showed that both websites and ChatGPT responses exceeded the recommended sixth grade reading level for health-related information.

screen.reason: Evaluates readability metrics of ChatGPT-generated health responses compared to online websites; does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
